# Sheet

> A panel that slides over the page from the right, for a task with more to it than a dialog: editing a client, an invoice's details.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/sheet/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/sheet.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Anatomy

- `root`: The browser's `<dialog>`, its own look taken away and moved to the window's right edge, full height.
- `backdrop`: The page behind, dimmed to 72% of its own colour, as Dialog's is.
- `panel`: The plate: the full height, 400px wide, the title at the top and the buttons pinned to the bottom.
- `title`: An `<h2>` in title type, medium weight.
- `body`: Paragraph type. It takes the room there is and scrolls.
- `actions`: The Buttons in a row on the right, 8px apart, at the bottom.

## When to use

- **A task beside the page.** Editing something from a list without leaving it: a client, an invoice's details. The list stays in sight behind it.

## When not to use

- **A quick question.** Yes or no, or two fields. That's **Dialog**.
- **A whole job.** Something that takes several screens. Give it a page.

## Behaviour

It's a `<dialog>` opened as a modal and moved to the right edge, full height: the browser does focus, Esc and the page behind. The page dims as it does for Dialog. It doesn't slide in yet; it appears.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`, labelled by its title.
- **Name**: The title.
- **Keyboard**: Focus starts inside and stays there until it closes. Esc closes it.
- **Focus**: When it closes, focus goes back to what opened it.
- **Colour**: The title is 14:1 and the words 11:1 on the plate, in dark.

## Content

The title says what's being done (Edit client); the buttons say how it ends (Cancel, Save).
